company.name: Valiu
company.shortDescription: Enabling the first crypto-economy in Venezuela
company.description:
Valiu is a fintech company that provides borderless financial services to all Venezuelans. It has created a mobile application that allows access to a convenient dollar savings and transfer system for any migrant or family member, regardless of their socioeconomic status or the range of their phone. 

The company was co-founded by Simon Chamorro and Alberto Niego in 2018.
